Client API

group BLOB_TRANSFER_CLIENT_API

Functions declaration.

Functions

bool blob_transfer_client_reg(uint8_t element_index, model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Register BLOB transfer client.

Registers the BLOB transfer client model on a specific element.

Parameters:

  • element_index -- [in] The index of the element where the model is to be registered.

  • model_data_cb -- [in] Callback function for model data processing.

Return values:

  • true -- Registration is successful.

  • false -- Registration failed due to incorrect element index.

Returns:

Registration result.

void blob_transfer_client_set_send_cb(model_send_cb_pf model_send_cb)

Set the BLOB transfer client model send callback function.

Sets the callback function for sending operations of the client model.

Parameters:

model_send_cb -- [in] The model send callback function.

void blob_transfer_client_set_data_cb(model_data_cb_pf model_data_cb)

Set the BLOB transfer client model data callback function.

Sets the callback function to handle model data for the client.

Parameters:

model_data_cb -- [in] The model data callback function.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_transfer_get(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Get the BLOB transfer.

Requests the status of the ongoing BLOB transfer from a destination address.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Status request sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send status request due to timeout.

Returns:

Request operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_transfer_start(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, blob_transfer_mode_t mode, uint8_t blob_id[8], uint32_t blob_size, uint8_t block_size_log, uint16_t client_mtu_size)

Start a BLOB transfer.

Initiates a BLOB transfer to a destination address with specified parameters.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • mode -- [in] The BLOB transfer mode:

    • BLOB_TRANSFER_MODE_PUSH for push mode.

    • BLOB_TRANSFER_MODE_PULL for pull mode.

  • blob_id -- [in] The BLOB identifier (8 bytes).

  • blob_size -- [in] The size of the BLOB.

  • block_size_log -- [in] The logarithm of the block size.

  • client_mtu_size -- [in] The client MTU size.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Transfer started successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to start transfer due to invalid MTU size.

Returns:

Start operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_transfer_cancel(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint8_t blob_id[8])

Cancel a BLOB transfer.

Cancels the ongoing BLOB transfer to a specific destination.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • blob_id -- [in] The BLOB identifier (8 bytes).

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Transfer cancellation is successful.

  • Others -- Transfer cancellation failed due to network error.

Returns:

Cancel operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_block_get(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Get the status of a BLOB block.

Requests the status of a specific BLOB block from a destination address.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Block status request sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send block status request due to transmission error.

Returns:

Block status request result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_block_start(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint16_t block_num, uint16_t chunk_size)

Start a BLOB block transfer.

Initiates a transfer for a specific block of a BLOB.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • block_num -- [in] The total block number.

  • chunk_size -- [in] The transfer chunk size.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Block transfer started successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to start block transfer due to invalid block number.

Returns:

Block transfer operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_chunk_transfer(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index, uint16_t chunk_num, uint8_t *pdata, uint16_t len)

Start a BLOB chunk transfer.

Initiates a transfer for a specific chunk of a block.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

  • chunk_num -- [in] The total chunk number.

  • pdata -- [in] Pointer to the chunk data.

  • len -- [in] Length of the chunk data.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Chunk transfer started successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to start chunk transfer due to data length exceeding MTU size.

Returns:

Chunk transfer operation result.

mesh_msg_send_cause_t blob_info_get(uint16_t dst, uint16_t app_key_index)

Get BLOB transfer information.

Requests the transfer information from a destination address.

Parameters:

  • dst -- [in] The destination address.

  • app_key_index -- [in] The app key index used for sending.

Return values:

  • MESH_MSG_SEND_CAUSE_SUCCESS -- Information request sent successfully.

  • Others -- Failed to send information request due to network instability.

Returns:

Information request result.
